news.headline: The kicker missed from 50 yards out late in the fourth quarter when the game was well in hand. Butker is 6-of-8 on field
news.detail: The kicker missed from 50 yards out late in the fourth quarter when the game was well in hand. Butker is 6-of-8 on field-goal tries and 10-of-10 on extra-point attempts in 2026. He is getting enough opportunities in the Chiefs' new-look offense to average double-digit points in fantasy.
